title: How Much Does Farm Management Software Cost, and What Support Should I Expect?
metaTitle: Farm Management Software Cost: Prices, Plans and Support
metaDescription: Farm management software cost explained: free, monthly, yearly and credit pricing, the costs people forget, the support to ask for, and anee.io's prices.
excerpt: Farm management software cost runs from free to a monthly or yearly fee, and some tools charge by area, by user or in credits for AI work. Count the hidden costs too: a phone, mobile data and your time to learn it. anee.io, a farm app built for Filipino farmers, is free on its Libre plan, and paid plans run from PHP 70 to PHP 600 a month by GCash or bank transfer. Help comes by email and from inside the app.

blocks.text:
A Filipino farmer needs a plain answer about software prices. What will this cost each season, in pesos, and who helps when it does not work?

The price tag is only part of it. Software can save time over paper. Still, you need basic computer skills and time to learn the tool and set it up. Below are the pricing models, the forgotten costs, the support to ask for, and the real prices of anee.io.

items: Prices come in six forms: free, one time, monthly, yearly, per hectare or user, and credits for AI.
Add the costs that do not show on the price tag: phone, data, storage and your time.
Ask how support works before you pay: email, in app help, videos, and how fast a person answers.
anee.io starts free. Libre plus Anee costs PHP 70 a month, Solo Farmer PHP 200 and Farm Owner PHP 600.

blocks.text: How is farm management software priced?
Sellers use a few pricing models, and many mix two of them. Know which one you are buying, because it decides what the bill looks like as your farm grows.

blocks.text: How much does advanced farm analytics software cost?

There is no fair typical price to quote. Some platforms charge by area, and some give a price only after a demo, so one tool can cost two farms very different amounts. Before any demo, ask for the full yearly price in pesos for your hectares and your team.

In anee.io, the analytics side runs on credits. Each analysis, such as What to Plant or Satellite Analysis, shows its price in credits before it runs. Solo Farmer comes with 30 AI credits each renewal and Farm Owner with 100, and you can buy more. Credits do not expire.

blocks.text:
Offline mode comes with every plan. On Farm Owner, your workers log in under your plan and pay nothing themselves. The full list is on the [pricing page](/pricing).

For scale, the 2024 average cost of producing palay was PHP 59,695 per hectare. So a year of Solo Farmer comes to about 3 percent of one hectare's cost for one season. Our guide to [farm expense management software](/blog/farm-expense-management-software) works it out per crop.

items: **A phone that can run it.** anee.io works in the browser of any phone, tablet or computer.
**Mobile data.** Ticks and notes use little, while photos and video use the most.
**Storage.** Ask what happens when the space runs out. Libre holds 1 GB and Solo Farmer 6 GB, and paid plans can add more.
**AI credits beyond the ones included.** Check the price shown before each analysis.
**Your time.** Plan a few evenings to set up lots, workers and stock.
**Leaving later.** Moving records between programs takes work, so read how to [digitize farm records](/blog/digitize-farm-records) before you start.

blocks.title: Pay monthly first, then yearly
blocks.text: Try a paid plan for one month during a busy part of the season, such as top dressing or harvest. If you still open it every day after that month, switch to yearly and keep the savings. If you do not, step back to Libre and you lose nothing you recorded.
How do I subscribe to a paid plan?
Many apps sell their paid features from a page inside the app, called Plans, Billing or Subscription. In anee.io it works like this.

items.title: Open My Subscription
items.text: Inside the app, open My Subscription and pick a plan, monthly or yearly.

items.title: Pay by GCash or bank transfer
items.text: Pay the amount shown, in pesos. You do not need a credit card.

items.title: Send the receipt
items.text: Upload a screenshot of the receipt on the same screen.

items.title: Your plan turns on
items.text: A GCash receipt usually clears in about a minute, and other payments usually within 24 hours. Your plan starts once the payment clears.

blocks.text: Plans never renew or charge you by themselves. The app shows when your plan is about to end, and you renew by paying again. If you renew early, the new days go on top of the old ones. When a plan ends, your account returns to Libre, and you can still read your records.

blocks.title: Start free, pay only when the farm needs more
blocks.text: Sign up for Libre, run one season, and upgrade from inside the app when you hire workers or want Anee.

Sellers of farm tracking software offer some mix of help pages, videos, email, chat, phone lines and training. Ask which of these your plan includes, and how fast a real person answers.

Questions about farm management software cost

items.q: Is there free farm management software?
items.a: Yes. The Libre plan of anee.io is free with no end date and shows a few ads. The PalayCheck App also shows a price of zero on Google Play, for rice. Our guide to [farm management software](/blog/farm-management-software) compares the free options.

items.q: Does anee.io charge me automatically every month?
items.a: No. Plans never renew or charge you by themselves. You pay in advance by GCash or bank transfer, and you renew by paying again.

items.q: What happens to my records when my plan ends?
items.a: Your account returns to Libre, and your records stay where you can read them. Features beyond Libre lock until you renew. Renew any time and pick up where the season left off.

anee.io refunds or corrects a payment made twice, a wrong amount, or one it could not confirm. If a serious problem on its side blocks you, it gives a fair refund or extra time. Apart from those cases, a started plan period and bought credits are not refundable. Email support@anee.io within 30 days of the payment, with your reference number.
No. Credits stay on your account until you spend them, across seasons. If your plan ends, unused credits wait for you until you renew.
